title: Hold a commercial agent licence
what: Hold a commercial agent's licence before carrying on business as a commercial agent.

laws.title: Commercial and Private Agents Licensing Act 1979 (NT)

sources.title: Commercial and Private Agents Licensing Act 1979 (NT)
sources.quote: a person must not carry on business as a commercial agent, an inquiry agent, a process server or a private bailiff unless he or she has been issued a licence of the appropriate category.
